evals.prompt: I'm building an AI-powered data app with Spice. I need to connect to PostgreSQL, enable search on a text column, add GPT-4o for chat, and configure caching. Generate me a complete spicepod.yaml.
evals.expected_output: Complete spicepod.yaml with secrets, datasets (postgres with acceleration and embeddings), embedding model, LLM model with tools, and runtime caching config

assertions.name: valid_spicepod_structure
assertions.description: Should have valid spicepod header on the current manifest version (v2)

assertions.name: has_caching
assertions.description: Should include caching or runtime configuration

assertions.name: has_embeddings
assertions.description: Should include embeddings section for search

evals.prompt: What sections can I put in a spicepod.yaml? Give me an overview of everything Spice supports.
evals.expected_output: List all sections: datasets, catalogs, views, models, embeddings, rerankers, tools, workers, functions, secrets, runtime, snapshots, management, metadata, dependencies (no evals — removed in v2.0.0)

evals.prompt: How do I set up Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry tracing for my Spice app?
evals.expected_output: Configure runtime.telemetry section with otel_exporter endpoint, mention the Prometheus metrics endpoint is disabled by default and enabled with the --metrics flag (e.g. 127.0.0.1:9090)

evals.prompt: I have an old spicepod from Spice v1.11 with an `evals:` section and a `runtime.results_cache` block. What do I need to change to run it on Spice v2.3?
evals.expected_output: The evals section (and /v1/evals) was removed in v2.0.0, so delete it; runtime.results_cache is deprecated in favor of runtime.caching.sql_results (cache_max_size becomes max_size) and auto-migrates; set version: v2

assertions.name: evals_removed
assertions.description: Should say the evals section was removed

assertions.name: uses_v2_manifest
assertions.description: Should recommend the v2 manifest version
